`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspac

e` **0.2.1-rc.3** client bundle is vendored
byte-for-byte, and an ordered patch pipeline derives `li

three-section layout on top of it:

**Active -> Session tasks -> Inactive**, with the official search, archive
filters, row menus, hover

buttons/cards, workspace management, drag & drop,
watermark rows, status dots and shortcuts kept in

tact because they are still the
official code.

ory), and the

## Compatibility

- DSH: `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0` (declared as `dsh.engines.dsh`). The browser half
is generated from the

0.2.1-rc.3 official bundle; a newer DSH release needs the
baseline re-extracted and the patch ancho

rs re-checked
(docs/upgrade-checklist.md).
- The fixed middle segment is a real workspace at the Win

dows path
`D:\files\history-tasks` (title `会话任务`). The plugin is therefore
Windows-oriented today: o

n another platform that literal path is not a normal
directory. Everything else is platform-neutral.

- While enabled, this bundle disables the shipped `ui-workspace` loader row and
runs the official b

rowser code itself; disabling or uninstalling the bundle
restores the shipped row unchanged. The off

icial package files are never
modified.
## Why the plugin replaces the shipped plugin row

The official browser owns `sidebar.workspaces` **and declares that region's child
slots** (session "

..." menu rows, row hover actions, directory flow, row
leading/hover cells). The slot ledger allows

only one registration to declare a
given child slot, and the renderer only authorises a registration

to render the
children it declared itself. A second, lower-priority occupant therefore cannot
reuse

those slots - it would have to redraw the menus and dialogs, which is
exactly what this rewrite is

it would have to redraw the menus and dialogs, which is
exactly what this rewrite is meant to avoid.

So this bundle is a **replacement**: its `cordis.patch.yml` disables the shipped
`ui-workspace` load

er row while the bundle is enabled, and the bundle runs the
official client code itself with the sec

tion patches. The official package in
`app.asar` is never modified. Disabling or uninstalling the bu

ndle removes its
patch layer and the shipped row returns unchanged.

"Switch back to the official list" is a rendering mode of the same patched
component tree (`sections

.mode === "native"` -> the official derivation and
render path), not a second registration; the full

-screen list looks and behaves
exactly like the shipped one, keeps the official view state, and surv

ives a page
refresh.

## Build and test

Requirements: Node.js 24 (this machine: `C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe`).
Run from the plugin dir
ectory (or pass the absolute path).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The build:

1. reads `patches/manifest.json`;
2. verifies the vendored baseline **bytes and SHA256** (first 16 h

ports each patch module in manifest order and calls `apply(source)`;
every patch asserts its anchors

and throws if an anchor is not unique;
4. writes the result to a temporary file and runs `node --ch
s and the output SHA256.

**`lib/client.js` is a generated artifact - never hand-edit it.** Every change
lands in `vendor/` (b
aseline refresh) or `patches/*.mjs`.
## Install / enable / disable / uninstall

Installing is a profile operation: the package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so
`dsh plugin add` link

s it into the profile and appends
`dsh-sidebar-sections` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. Use the profile y

ou
actually run (the Desktop app uses `desktop`; `dsh web` commonly uses `web`).
[代码示例省略，未执行]

On the Desktop app, quit the app before running the CLI (profile files are
locked), or use the in-ap

p plugin manager. After the bundle is selected, the
browser half loads on the next client boot; a pa

ge refresh (or
disable -> enable) picks up a rebuilt `lib/client.js`.
### Enable / disable

- **In the app:** Settings -> Plugins -> toggle
`dsh-sidebar-sections`; or
- **as an agent tool:** `

plugin_manager` `{ "action": "set_bundle",
"target": "dsh-sidebar-sections", "enabled": false }` (th

en `true`
to re-enable); or
- profile fallback: leave the package out of `dsh.profile.bundles`.

Disabling the bundle removes its patch layer, which re-enables the shipped
`ui-workspace` row - the

official sidebar returns. Re-enabling mounts the
sections build again and is also the way to pick up

a rebuilt `lib/client.js`
while the app is running (the client bundle reloads live when the profile
bundle list changes).
